metadata.label: negative
metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: A photorealistic kitchen counter with exactly five identical red apples arranged in a straight line facing a large vanity mirror, the mirror reflection displays only four apples in the row, sharp overhead lighting, high detail, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: The number of apples in the reflection does not match the actual physical count on the counter.
